entries.name: TensorStructure.pairProd_tmul_tprod_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma pairProd_tmul_tprod_tprod (fx : (i : X) → 𝓣.ColorModule (cX i))
    (fx2 : (i : X) → 𝓣.ColorModule (cX2 i)) :
    𝓣.pairProd (PiTensorProduct.tprod R fx ⊗ₜ[R] PiTensorProduct.tprod R fx2) =
    PiTensorProduct.tprod R (fun x => fx x ⊗ₜ[R] fx2 x)

entries.name: TensorStructure.contrAll'_tmul_tprod_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma contrAll'_tmul_tprod_tprod (fx : (i : X) → 𝓣.ColorModule (cX i))
    (fy : (i : X) → 𝓣.ColorModule (𝓣.τ (cX i))) :
    𝓣.contrAll' (PiTensorProduct.tprod R fx ⊗ₜ[R] PiTensorProduct.tprod R fy) =
    (PiTensorProduct.lift (MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra R X R))
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod R (fun x => 𝓣.contrDual (cX x) (fx x ⊗ₜ[R] fy x)))

entries.name: TensorStructure.contrAll'_isEmpty_tmul
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma contrAll'_isEmpty_tmul [IsEmpty X] (x : 𝓣.Tensor cX) (y : 𝓣.Tensor (𝓣.τ ∘ cX)) :
    𝓣.contrAll' (x ⊗ₜ y) = 𝓣.isEmptyEquiv x * 𝓣.isEmptyEquiv y

entries.name: TensorStructure.contrAll_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma contrAll_tmul (e : X ≃ Y) (h : cX.ContrAll e cY) (x : 𝓣.Tensor cX) (y : 𝓣.Tensor cY) :
    𝓣.contrAll e h (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = 𝓣.contrAll' (x ⊗ₜ[R] ((𝓣.mapIso e.symm h.symm.toMapIso) y))

entries.name: TensorStructure.contr_tprod
entries.snippet:
lemma contr_tprod (e : (C ⊕ C) ⊕ P ≃ X) (h : cX.ContrCond e) (f : (i : X) → 𝓣.ColorModule (cX i)) :
    𝓣.contr e h (tprod R f) = (𝓣.contrAll (Equiv.refl C) h.to_contrAll
        (tprod R (fun i => f (e (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)))) ⊗ₜ[R]
        tprod R (fun i => f (e (Sum.inl (Sum.inr i)))))) •
        tprod R (fun (p : P) => f (e (Sum.inr p)))

entries.name: TensorStructure.contr_tprod_isEmpty
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma contr_tprod_isEmpty [IsEmpty C] (e : (C ⊕ C) ⊕ P ≃ X) (h : cX.ContrCond e)
    (f : (i : X) → 𝓣.ColorModule (cX i)) :
    𝓣.contr e h (tprod R f) = tprod R (fun (p : P) => f (e (Sum.inr p)))

entries.name: einsteinTensor.fromIndexStringColor
entries.docstring:
The construction of a tensor index from a tensor and a string satisfying conditions
  which can be automatically checked. This is a modified version of
  `TensorStructure.TensorIndex.mkDualMap` specific to real Lorentz tensors.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fromIndexStringColor {R : Type} [CommSemiring R]
    {cn : Fin n → einsteinTensorColor.Color}
    (T : (einsteinTensor R m).Tensor cn) (s : String)
    (hs : listCharIsIndexString einsteinTensorColor.Color s.toList = true)
    (hn : n = (toIndexList' s hs).length)
    (hD : (toIndexList' s hs).OnlyUniqueDuals)
    (hC : IndexList.ColorCond.bool (toIndexList' s hs))
    (hd : TensorColor.ColorMap.DualMap.boolFin'
      (toIndexList' s hs).colorMap (cn ∘ Fin.cast hn.symm)) :
    (einsteinTensor R m).TensorIndex

lemma fromIndexStringColor_indexList {R : Type} [CommSemiring R]
    {cn : Fin n → einsteinTensorColor.Color}
    (T : (einsteinTensor R m).Tensor cn) (s : String)
    (hs : listCharIsIndexString einsteinTensorColor.Color s.toList = true)
    (hn : n = (toIndexList' s hs).length)
    (hD : (toIndexList' s hs).OnlyUniqueDuals)
    (hC : IndexList.ColorCond.bool (toIndexList' s hs))
    (hd : TensorColor.ColorMap.DualMap.boolFin'

    (fromIndexStringColor T s hs hn hD hC hd).toIndexList = toIndexList' s hs

entries.name: IndexNotation.ColorIndexList
entries.docstring:
A list of indices with the additional constraint that if a index has a dual,
  that dual is unique, and the dual of an index has dual color to that index.

  This is the permissible type of indices which can be used for a tensor. For example,
  the index list `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵤ₁']` can be extended to a `ColorIndexList` but the index list
  `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵤ₁', 'ᵤ₁']` cannot.

entries.name: IndexNotation.ColorIndexList.ContrPerm
entries.docstring:
Two `ColorIndexList`s are said to be related by contracted permutations, `ContrPerm`,
  if and only if:

    1) Their contractions are the same length.
    2) Every index in the contracted list of one has a unqiue dual in the contracted
      list of the other and that dual has a the same color.
entries.snippet: def ContrPerm : Prop

entries.name: IndexNotation.ColorIndexList.ContrPerm.getDualInOtherEquiv_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma getDualInOtherEquiv_eq (h : l.ContrPerm l2) (i : Fin l.contr.length) :
    l2.contr.val.get (l.contr.getDualInOtherEquiv l2.contr ⟨i, by
    rw [h.2.1]
    exact Finset.mem_univ i⟩).1 = l.contr.val.get i

entries.snippet:
lemma mem_snd_of_mem_snd (h : l.ContrPerm l2) {I : Index 𝓒.Color} (hI : I ∈ l.contr.val) :
    I ∈ l2.contr.val

entries.snippet:
lemma countSelf_eq_one_snd_of_countSelf_eq_one_fst (h : l.ContrPerm l2) {I : Index 𝓒.Color}

entries.snippet:
lemma getDualInOtherEquiv_eq_of_countSelf
    (hn : IndexList.Subperm l.contr l2.contr.toIndexList) (i : Fin l.contr.length)
    (h1 : l2.contr.countId (l.contr.val.get i) = 1)
    (h2 : l2.contr.countSelf (l.contr.val.get i) = 1) :
    l2.contr.val.get (l.contr.getDualInOtherEquiv l2.contr ⟨i, by
      rw [hn]
      exact Finset.mem_univ i⟩).1 = l.contr.val.get i

lemma colorMap_eq_of_countSelf (hn : IndexList.Subperm l.contr l2.contr.toIndexList)
    (h2 : ∀ i, l.contr.countSelf (l.contr.val.get i) = 1

@[simp]
lemma getDualInOtherEquiv_symm : (l.getDualInOtherEquiv l2).symm = l2.getDualInOtherEquiv l

def withUniqueDualCastLeft (h : l = l3) :

def withUniqueDualCastRight (h : l2 = l3) :

def withUniqueDualCast {l1 l2 l1' l2' : IndexList X} (h : l1 = l1') (h2 : l2 = l2') :

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.dedup_map_of_injective'
entries.snippet:
lemma dedup_map_of_injective' {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (f : α → ℕ)
    (l : List α) (hf : ∀ I ∈ l, ∀ J ∈ l, f I = f J ↔ I = J) :
    (l.map f).dedup = l.dedup.map f

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.indexOf_map
entries.snippet:
lemma indexOf_map {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (f : α → ℕ) (l : List α) (n : α) (hf : ∀ I ∈ l, ∀ J, f I = f J ↔ I = J) :
    l.indexOf n = (l.map f).indexOf (f n)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.indexOf_map_fin
entries.snippet:
lemma indexOf_map_fin {α : Type} {m : ℕ} [DecidableEq α]
    (f : α → (Fin m)) (l : List α) (n : α) (hf : ∀ I ∈ l, ∀ J, f I = f J ↔ I = J) :
    l.indexOf n = (l.map f).indexOf (f n)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.indexOf_map'
entries.snippet:
lemma indexOf_map' {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (f : α → ℕ) (g : α → α) (l : List α) (n : α)
    (hf : ∀ I ∈ l, ∀ J, f I = f J ↔ g I = g J)
    (hg : ∀ I ∈ l, g I = I)
    (hs : ∀ I, f I = f (g I)) :
    l.indexOf (g n) = (l.map f).indexOf (f n)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.filter_dedup
entries.snippet:
lemma filter_dedup {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (l.filter p).dedup = (l.dedup.filter p)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.findIdx?_map
entries.snippet:
lemma findIdx?_map {α β : Type} (p : α → Bool)
    (f : β → α) (l : List β) :
    List.findIdx? p (List.map f l) = List.findIdx? (p ∘ f) l

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.findIdx?_on_finRange
entries.snippet:
lemma findIdx?_on_finRange {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n.succ → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (hp : ¬ p 0) :
    List.findIdx? p (List.finRange n.succ) =
    Option.map (fun i => i + 1) (List.findIdx? (p ∘ Fin.succ) (List.finRange n))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.findIdx?_on_finRange_eq_findIdx
entries.snippet:
lemma findIdx?_on_finRange_eq_findIdx {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    List.findIdx? p (List.finRange n) = Option.map Fin.val (Fin.find p)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idListFin
entries.docstring:
The list of elements of `Fin l.length` `i` is in `idListFin` if
  `l.idMap i` appears for the first time in the `i`th spot.

  For example, for the list `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵘ²', 'ᵤ₁']` the `idListFin` is `[0, 1]`.
entries.snippet: def idListFin : List (Fin l.length)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idListFin_getDualInOther?
entries.snippet:
lemma idListFin_getDualInOther? : l.idListFin =
    (List.finRange l.length).filter (fun i => l.getDualInOther? l i = i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idList
entries.docstring: The list of ids keeping only the first appearance of each id.
entries.snippet: def idList : List ℕ

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idList_getDualInOther?
entries.snippet:
lemma idList_getDualInOther? : l.idList =
    List.map l.idMap ((List.finRange l.length).filter (fun i => l.getDualInOther? l i = i))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.mem_idList_of_mem
entries.snippet: lemma mem_idList_of_mem {I : Index X} (hI : I ∈ l.val) : I.id ∈ l.idList

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idMap_mem_idList
entries.snippet: lemma idMap_mem_idList (i : Fin l.length) : l.idMap i ∈ l.idList

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idList_indexOf_mem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma idList_indexOf_mem {I J : Index X} (hI : I ∈ l.val) (hJ : J ∈ l.val) :
    l.idList.indexOf I.id = l.idList.indexOf J.id ↔ I.id = J.id

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.idList_indexOf_get
entries.snippet:
lemma idList_indexOf_get (i : Fin l.length) :
    l.idList.indexOf (l.idMap i) = l.idListFin.indexOf ((l.getDualInOther? l i).get
      (getDualInOther?_self_isSome l i))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast
entries.docstring:
Two `IndexList`s are related by `GetDualCast` if they are the same length,
  and have the same dual structure.

  For example, `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵘ²', 'ᵤ₁']` and `['ᵤ₄', 'ᵘ⁵', 'ᵤ₄']` are related by `GetDualCast`,
  but `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵘ²', 'ᵤ₁']` and `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵘ²', 'ᵤ₃']` are not.
entries.snippet: def GetDualCast : Prop

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.symm
entries.snippet: lemma symm (h : GetDualCast l l2) : GetDualCast l2 l

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.getDual?_isSome_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_isSome_iff (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (l.getDual? i).isSome ↔ (l2.getDual? (Fin.cast h.1 i)).isSome

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.getDual?_get
entries.snippet:
lemma getDual?_get (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i : Fin l.length) (h1 : (l.getDual? i).isSome) :
    (l.getDual? i).get h1 = Fin.cast h.1.symm ((l2.getDual? (Fin.cast h.1 i)).get
    ((getDual?_isSome_iff h i).mp h1))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.areDualInSelf_of
entries.snippet:
lemma areDualInSelf_of (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i j : Fin l.length) (hA : l.AreDualInSelf i j) :
    l2.AreDualInSelf (Fin.cast h.1 i) (Fin.cast h.1 j)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.areDualInSelf_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma areDualInSelf_iff (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i j : Fin l.length) : l.AreDualInSelf i j ↔
    l2.AreDualInSelf (Fin.cast h.1 i) (Fin.cast h.1 j)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.idMap_eq_of
entries.snippet:
lemma idMap_eq_of (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i j : Fin l.length) (hm : l.idMap i = l.idMap j) :
    l2.idMap (Fin.cast h.1 i) = l2.idMap (Fin.cast h.1 j)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.idMap_eq_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma idMap_eq_iff (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i j : Fin l.length) :
    l.idMap i = l.idMap j ↔ l2.idMap (Fin.cast h.1 i) = l2.idMap (Fin.cast h.1 j)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.iff_idMap_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma iff_idMap_eq : GetDualCast l l2 ↔
    l.length = l2.length ∧ ∀ (h : l.length = l2.length) i j,
    l.idMap i = l.idMap j ↔ l2.idMap (Fin.cast h i) = l2.idMap (Fin.cast h j)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.refl
entries.snippet: lemma refl (l : IndexList X) : GetDualCast l l

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.trans
entries.snippet:
@[trans]
lemma trans (h : GetDualCast l l2) (h' : GetDualCast l2 l3) : GetDualCast l l3

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.getDualInOther?_get
entries.snippet:
lemma getDualInOther?_get (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (l.getDualInOther? l i).get (getDualInOther?_self_isSome l i) = (Fin.cast h.1.symm)
    ((l2.getDualInOther? l2 (Fin.cast h.1 i)).get
      (getDualInOther?_self_isSome l2 (Fin.cast h.left i)))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.countId_cast
entries.snippet:
lemma countId_cast (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i : Fin l.length) :
    l.countId (l.val.get i) = l2.countId (l2.val.get (Fin.cast h.1 i))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.idListFin_cast
entries.snippet:
lemma idListFin_cast (h : GetDualCast l l2) :
    List.map (Fin.cast h.1) l.idListFin = l2.idListFin

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.idList_indexOf
entries.snippet:
lemma idList_indexOf (h : GetDualCast l l2) (i : Fin l.length) :
    l2.idList.indexOf (l2.idMap (Fin.cast h.1 i)) = l.idList.indexOf (l.idMap i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize
entries.docstring:
Given an index list `l`, the corresponding index list where id's are set to
  sequentially lowest values.

  E.g. on `['ᵘ¹', 'ᵘ³', 'ᵤ₁']` this gives `['ᵘ⁰', 'ᵘ¹', 'ᵤ₀']`.
entries.snippet: def normalize : IndexList X where

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_eq_map
entries.snippet:
lemma normalize_eq_map :
    l.normalize.val = List.map (fun I => ⟨I.toColor, l.idList.indexOf I.id⟩) l.val

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_length
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_length : l.normalize.length = l.length

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_val_length
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_val_length : l.normalize.val.length = l.val.length

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_colorMap
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_colorMap : l.normalize.colorMap = l.colorMap ∘ Fin.cast l.normalize_length

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.colorMap_normalize
entries.snippet:
lemma colorMap_normalize :
    l.colorMap = l.normalize.colorMap ∘ Fin.cast l.normalize_length.symm

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_countId
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_countId (i : Fin l.normalize.length) :
    l.normalize.countId l.normalize.val[Fin.val i] =
    l.countId (l.val.get ⟨i, by simpa using i.2⟩)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_countId'
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_countId' (i : Fin l.length) (hi : i.1 < l.normalize.length) :
    l.normalize.countId (l.normalize.val[Fin.val i]) = l.countId (l.val.get i)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_countId_mem
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_countId_mem (I : Index X) (h : I ∈ l.val) :
    l.normalize.countId (I.toColor, List.indexOf I.id l.idList) = l.countId I

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_filter_countId_eq_one
entries.snippet:
lemma normalize_filter_countId_eq_one :
    List.map Index.id (l.normalize.val.filter (fun I => l.normalize.countId I = 1))
    = List.map l.idList.indexOf (List.map Index.id (l.val.filter (fun I => l.countId I = 1)))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_idMap_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_idMap_apply (i : Fin l.normalize.length) :
    l.normalize.idMap i = l.idList.indexOf (l.val.get ⟨i, by simpa using i.2⟩).id

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_getDualCast_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_getDualCast_self : GetDualCast l.normalize l

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.self_getDualCast_normalize
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma self_getDualCast_normalize : GetDualCast l l.normalize

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_filter_countId_not_eq_one
entries.snippet:
lemma normalize_filter_countId_not_eq_one :
    List.map Index.id (l.normalize.val.filter (fun I => ¬ l.normalize.countId I = 1))
    = List.map l.idList.indexOf
    (List.map Index.id (l.val.filter (fun I => ¬ l.countId I = 1)))

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.to_normalize
entries.snippet: lemma to_normalize (h : GetDualCast l l2) : GetDualCast l.normalize l2.normalize

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.normalize_idMap_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma normalize_idMap_eq (h : GetDualCast l l2) :
    l.normalize.idMap = l2.normalize.idMap ∘ Fin.cast h.to_normalize.1

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.GetDualCast.iff_normalize
entries.snippet:
lemma iff_normalize : GetDualCast l l2 ↔
    l.normalize.length = l2.normalize.length ∧ ∀ (h : l.normalize.length = l2.normalize.length),
    l.normalize.idMap = l2.normalize.idMap ∘ Fin.cast h

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_normalize
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma normalize_normalize : l.normalize.normalize = l.normalize

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_length_eq_of_eq_length
entries.snippet:
lemma normalize_length_eq_of_eq_length (h : l.length = l2.length) :
    l.normalize.length = l2.normalize.length

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.normalize_colorMap_eq_of_eq_colorMap
entries.snippet:
lemma normalize_colorMap_eq_of_eq_colorMap (h : l.length = l2.length)
    (hc : l.colorMap = l2.colorMap ∘ Fin.cast h) :
    l.normalize.colorMap = l2.normalize.colorMap ∘
    Fin.cast (normalize_length_eq_of_eq_length l l2 h)

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.Reindexing
entries.docstring:
Two `ColorIndexList` are said to be reindexes of one another if they:
    1. have the same length.
    2. every corresponding index has the same color, and duals which correspond.

  Note: This does not allow for reordering of indices.

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.OnlyUniqueDuals
entries.docstring:
The conditon on an index list which is true if and only if for every index with a dual,
  that dual is unique.
entries.snippet: def OnlyUniqueDuals : Prop

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.OnlyUniqueDuals.iff_unique_forall
entries.snippet:
lemma iff_unique_forall :

lemma iff_countId_leq_two :

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.Subperm

An IndexList `l` is a subpermutation of `l2` if there are no duals in `l`, and

entries.snippet: def Subperm : Prop

lemma iff_countId_fin : l.Subperm l2 ↔

entries.name: IndexNotation.IndexList.Subperm.iff_countId
entries.snippet:
lemma iff_countId : l.Subperm l2 ↔
    ∀ I, l.countId I ≤ 1 ∧ (l.countId I = 1 → l2.countId I = 1)

entries.name: TensorColor.ColorMap.DualMap.split
entries.docstring: The splitting of `X` given two color maps based on the equality of the color.
entries.snippet: def split (c₁ c₂ : 𝓒.ColorMap X) : { x // c₁ x ≠ c₂ x} ⊕ { x // c₁ x = c₂ x} ≃ X

entries.name: TensorColor.ColorMap.DualMap.dual_eq_of_neq
entries.snippet:
lemma dual_eq_of_neq (h : DualMap c₁ c₂) {x : X} (h' : c₁ x ≠ c₂ x) :
    𝓒.τ (c₁ x) = c₂ x

entries.name: TensorColor.ColorMap.DualMap.split_dual
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma split_dual (h : DualMap c₁ c₂) : c₁.partDual (split c₁ c₂) = c₂

entries.name: TensorColor.ColorMap.DualMap.split_dual'
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma split_dual' (h : DualMap c₁ c₂) : c₂.partDual (split c₁ c₂) = c₁
